scope: Working local CMS; isolated browser context, no server publication

checks.name: Required field blocks publishing and focuses first invalid input
checks.detail: The English title was cleared; publishing preserved the other input and focused the invalid title.

checks.name: Preview is required before publication
checks.detail: An unpreviewed changed draft did not reach the published local store.

checks.name: Actual implementation preview reads the edited draft
checks.detail: The public project template rendered the amended English summary from the separate session preview store.

checks.name: Publish changes is read by the public website
checks.detail: A separate public page in this browser rendered the published summary. No external destination received data.

checks.name: Draft persists after reload
checks.detail: The changed summary and selected project were recovered from the separate draft store.

checks.name: Separate focal controls update the live project-page crop
checks.detail: Desktop horizontal focal point changed to 36%; the mobile point retained its original value. The opening image uses 16:9 desktop / 4:3 mobile, other story images 4:3, material details 16:7 desktop / 4:3 mobile, and diagrams show the full 8:5 drawing without cropping.

checks.name: Keyboard-capable story reorder retains text and image relation
checks.detail: Moving the first story down kept its English/Arabic record and exterior image together and restored focus to the moved control.

checks.name: Removed imagery blocks a missing relation without erasing story text
checks.detail: Removing the linked exterior image retained the moved chapter and its explanation; the missing chapter image was identified.

checks.name: Arabic editor preserves values and has no mobile overflow
checks.detail: At 390 px the interface switched to RTL, retained the long English draft title and absent optional area, and measured zero horizontal overflow.

checks.name: Long permitted title and absent optional area publish successfully
checks.detail: The bilingual draft was previewed and locally published with a long English title and an empty optional area.

checks.name: Storage failure preserves draft and offers retry
checks.detail: A controlled SecurityError left the typed draft intact and announced that browser storage must be enabled before retrying.
